sequenceDiagram
autonumber
participant W as Workflow Worker
participant H as Capability Host
participant B as Core Broker
participant C as Canonical Event Committer
participant L as Canonical History Backend
participant A as Desktop Event API
participant G as Projection Gateway
participant V as Conversation Presenter
W->>B: SpanStarted proposal for Run, GraphNode, or AgentLoop
B->>C: Commit microbatch with spanId and parentSpanId
C->>L: Append at expected head
L-->>C: Durable contiguous sequence range
C-->>A: Exact committed SpanStarted envelope
A-->>G: Async CoreEventEnvelope sequence N
G->>G: Reduce start and advance cursor
G-->>V: Render running span
H-->>B: ModelCall start with normalized redacted input
B->>C: Commit start boundary
C->>L: Durable append
L-->>C: Sequence N plus 1
C-->>A: Committed model start
A-->>G: Exact envelope
loop Source-supplied provider fragments
 H-->>B: Normalized reasoning, progress, or assistant fragment
 B->>B: Coalesce adjacent same span and channel only
 alt 50 ms, size limit, or semantic boundary
  B->>C: Commit SpanContentDelta microbatch
  C->>L: Durable append
  L-->>C: Committed sequence range
  C-->>A: Publish same deltas in order
  A-->>G: Exact envelopes
  G->>G: Append by span and channel
  G-->>V: Reactive content update
 end
end
H-->>B: Tool request with normalized redacted arguments
B->>C: Flush content, commit request and ModelCall terminal
C->>L: Durable append
L-->>C: Committed sequence range
C-->>A: Exact boundary events
A-->>G: Ordered envelopes
W->>B: ToolCall start under AgentLoop, caused by request event
B->>C: Commit tool start with input
C->>L: Durable append
L-->>C: Committed sequence
C-->>A: Committed tool start
A-->>G: Exact envelope
H-->>B: Tool result or error with normalized redacted output
B->>C: Commit ToolCall terminal
C->>L: Durable append
L-->>C: Committed sequence
C-->>A: Committed tool terminal
A-->>G: Exact envelope
G-->>V: Show tool after ModelCall with input and output
W->>B: Next ModelCall start using tool-result context
Note over W,V: Later reasoning belongs to the new ModelCall span
alt Reconnect or detected gap
 G->>A: Request events after cursor
 A-->>G: Exact committed delta
else Checkpoint selected
 G->>A: Request projection snapshot
 A-->>G: Snapshot throughSequence S plus exact tail
 G->>G: Hydrate and run same reducer over tail
end
